verdict.rationale: xAI's docs have a dedicated Structured Outputs page stating that when you use supported schema features, the response is guaranteed to match your schema. The grok-4.7 spec page lists "Structured outputs: Yes", so the JSON-schema-constrained path the story asks for is documented for the flagship model. The "supported schema features" qualifier implies a limited schema subset that the pack does not detail. Missing for 10: details of which schema features are supported, SDK-native typed output (e.g. Pydantic/Zod) evidence, independent hands-on corroboration.
